prompt: What is the name of the in-place, stable comparison sorting algorithm with a worst-case time complexity of O(n log n) and a best-case time complexity of O(n)?
answer:
The algorithm is **block sort** (also called **block merge sort**).

It is a comparison-based sort that is:

- **Stable**
- **In-place** (constant auxiliary memory)
- **Best case:** \(O(n)\)
- **Worst case:** \(O(n\log n)\)

It achieves this using block-based in-place stable merging.
